_meta.description: Living registry of all synergy_tags in use. Auto-updated when cards are tagged. Edit definitions and aliases manually.

edge_types.inherits: is-a relationship — child is a more specific version of parent. Queries on parent match children too.
edge_types.amplifies: synergy edge — having this tag in deck increases value of target tag
edge_types.requires: dependency edge — this card needs target tag present in deck to be effective

counter-doubler.definition: Card applies a replacement effect that increases the number of +1/+1 counters placed (e.g. 'that many plus one', 'twice that many'). Always passive-permanent.

replacement-effect.definition: Card uses a replacement effect (modifies how something happens, not a triggered ability). Key distinction from triggered abilities — applies to the event itself.

counter-amplifier.definition: General tag for cards that make counter placement produce more counters. Superset of counter-doubler.

passive-permanent.definition: Card has an always-on effect requiring no activation — it just sits on the battlefield and modifies game rules. High priority: these are the most consistent effects.

triggered-ability-doubler.definition: Card causes triggered abilities of a specific permanent type to trigger an additional time. Distinct from replacement effects — fires after the trigger, not instead of it.

can-become-chosen-type.definition: Card changes its own creature type based on a choice made on ETB ('this creature is the chosen type in addition to its other types'). Critical for tribal decks — means the card itself benefits from and contributes to tribal synergies.

tribal-enabler.definition: Card enables or amplifies a tribal strategy without necessarily being a member of the tribe.

human-tribal.definition: Card specifically references Humans by type, or IS a Human. Distinct from general tribal-enabler — only use for Human-specific synergies.

human-etb-payoff.definition: Card triggers or gains value specifically when a Human enters the battlefield. More specific than etb-trigger — only fires on Human ETBs.

counter-distribution.definition: Card distributes counters across multiple creatures simultaneously (board-wide placement, not single target).

board-wide-counter-placer.definition: Card puts +1/+1 counters on ALL or EACH creature you control simultaneously. Distinct from single-target-counter-placer. Key synergy target for counter-doublers.

single-target-counter-placer.definition: Card puts a counter on one specific target creature. Less powerful than board-wide-counter-placer in wide board strategies.

counter-mover.definition: Card moves or redistributes existing counters from one permanent to another. Requires counters already on the board — high context-dependency.

counter-consolidator.definition: Card moves ALL counters from one permanent to another (not partial). Creates high-value single threat from distributed counters.

reactive-protection.definition: Card with Flash that provides protection as a reaction to opponent's play (removal, wrath). The Flash is the key feature — it's protection that responds to a specific threat, not always-on.

board-protection.definition: Card protects ALL permanents or creatures you control (board-wide hexproof, indestructible, etc). High-value protection for wide strategies.

staple-protection.definition: Universally strong protection card that belongs in most EDH decks of its colors. Implies high necessity_score regardless of synergy with commander.

wrath-counter.definition: Card specifically counters or negates board wipes (mass removal). One of the most important categories in multiplayer EDH.

staple-mana-rock.definition: Artifact that produces mana and is universally played in EDH regardless of commander. Sol Ring is the archetype. High necessity_score by definition.

colorless-ramp.definition: Produces colorless mana ({C}). Useful in any deck regardless of color identity.

utility-land.definition: Non-basic land that provides an activated ability beyond just producing mana. Usually comes into play tapped or has conditions.

mana-sink.definition: Card provides a way to spend excess mana usefully in the late game. Important for decks that generate a lot of mana.

evasion-granter.definition: Card makes creatures harder or impossible to block. In counter strategies, unblockable = winning with big creatures.

etb-counter.definition: Card gains a +1/+1 counter when a creature enters the battlefield (its own ETB or others'). Scales with creature density.

scales-with-board.definition: Card's power or effect increases with the number of creatures on your side. High synergy with wide board strategies.

counter-placer.definition: Abstract parent: any card that places counters (board-wide or targeted)

counter-placement-events.definition: Abstract: represents the event of counters being placed — used in requires/amplifies

protection.definition: Abstract parent: any card that protects permanents

tribal-payoff.definition: Abstract parent: any card that gains value from tribal members

etb-trigger.definition: Abstract parent: any card with an enters-the-battlefield trigger

mana-rock.definition: Abstract parent: artifact that produces mana

ramp.definition: Abstract parent: any card that accelerates mana

token-generator.definition: Abstract parent: any card that creates tokens
